snippet.title: PSX Thunder Force V: Perfect System
snippet.description:
Support Shiryu on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Shiryu
https://www.facebook.com/ShiryuVideoGames/

Technosoft's "Thunder Force" was always a firm favorite on the Sega Megadrive, seemingly shifting more action on the screen than any Super Nintendo game I had back in the day. So it was with immense satisfaction that I learned the series was going 32 bit, not only on Sega Saturn but on Playstation as well! Sadly the game never arrived on European PAL territories, leaving me no choice but wait for the US version to be released in August 1998. The wait was well worth it, it might be now fully polygonal but the game shows it's hardcore 2D roots delivering a superb shmup that gathered praise by both reviewers and shmups fans. Enjoy!
